name: AerosolDirect
description:
Calculates the effective radiative forcing (ERF) from aerosol particles that interact directly
with solar radiation, by scattering (cooling) or absorption (warming).
Each species contributes in proportion to its emissions above pre-industrial levels,
with a species-specific radiative efficiency.

# What This Component Does

1. Calculates ERF from sulfate aerosols (SOx), which cool by scattering
2. Calculates ERF from black carbon (BC), which warms by absorption
3. Calculates ERF from organic carbon (OC), which cools by scattering
4. Calculates ERF from nitrate aerosols (from NOx), which cool by scattering
5. Distributes the total ERF across the four-box grid

# ERF Calculation

For each species $i$:

$$\Delta E_i = E_i - E_{i,pi}$$
$$ERF_i = \alpha_i \cdot \Delta E_i$$

The global ERF is the sum of the species contributions.

# Regional Distribution

The global ERF is distributed across the four regions using emission-weighted
regional patterns:

$$ERF_{region} = ERF_{global} \cdot \sum_i w_{i,region} \cdot |ERF_i| / \sum_i |ERF_i|$$

This weights the regional pattern by each species' share of the total ERF magnitude.

# Differences from MAGICC7

This is a simplified implementation:

- **Source separation**: MAGICC7 separates industrial and biomass sources for
  each species with different treatment. Here, all sources are combined.
- **Optical thickness**: MAGICC7 can use historical optical thickness data
  and extrapolate with emissions. Here, ERF scales linearly with emissions.
- **Dust and BC on snow**: MAGICC7 includes mineral dust and BC-on-snow forcing.
  Not implemented here.
- **Harmonisation**: MAGICC7 has several harmonisation methods (APPLY=0,1,2,3).
  The harmonisation parameters exist here but are not applied yet.
- **Nitrate chemistry**: MAGICC7 uses the Hauglustaine parameterisation with
  SOx-ammonia competition. Here, nitrate ERF scales linearly with NOx.
- **Efficacy**: MAGICC7 applies species-specific efficacy factors.
  Not implemented here.

inputs.name: Emissions|SOx
inputs.description: Sulfur dioxide emissions over the step

inputs.name: Emissions|BC
inputs.description: Black carbon emissions over the step

inputs.name: Emissions|OC
inputs.description: Organic carbon emissions over the step

inputs.name: Emissions|NOx
inputs.description: NOx emissions over the step, the precursor of nitrate aerosol

outputs.name: Effective Radiative Forcing|Aerosols|Direct Effect
outputs.description: Direct aerosol ERF in each region

parameters.name: sox_coefficient
parameters.description:
SOx forcing coefficient.

unit: W/m^2 per Mt S/yr

Negative (cooling) because sulfate aerosols scatter incoming solar radiation.

Default: -0.0035 W/m²/(Mt S/yr), calibrated to the AR6 best estimate.

parameters.name: bc_coefficient
parameters.description:
Black carbon forcing coefficient.

unit: W/m^2 per Mt BC/yr

Positive (warming) because BC absorbs solar radiation.

Default: 0.0077 W/m²/(Mt BC/yr)

parameters.name: oc_coefficient
parameters.description:
Organic carbon forcing coefficient.

unit: W/m^2 per Mt OC/yr

Negative (cooling) because OC mostly scatters radiation.

Default: -0.002 W/m²/(Mt OC/yr)

parameters.name: nitrate_coefficient
parameters.description:
Nitrate forcing coefficient.

unit: W/m^2 per Mt N/yr

Negative (cooling) because nitrate aerosols scatter radiation.

Default: -0.001 W/m²/(Mt N/yr)

parameters.name: sox_regional
parameters.description:
SOx regional pattern, as a fraction in each region of the four-box grid.

unit: dimensionless

The default is concentrated in the Northern Hemisphere, especially over land.

parameters.name: bc_regional
parameters.description:
BC regional pattern, as a fraction in each region of the four-box grid.

unit: dimensionless

The default is concentrated in the Northern Hemisphere.

parameters.name: oc_regional
parameters.description:
OC regional pattern, as a fraction in each region of the four-box grid.

unit: dimensionless

The default is like SOx but more uniform.

parameters.name: nitrate_regional
parameters.description:
Nitrate regional pattern, as a fraction in each region of the four-box grid.

unit: dimensionless

The default is concentrated in the Northern Hemisphere.

parameters.name: sox_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial SOx emissions, from natural volcanic sources by default

unit: Mt S/yr

Default: 1.0 Mt S/yr (natural volcanic)

parameters.name: bc_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial BC emissions, from biomass burning by default

unit: Mt BC/yr

Default: 2.5 Mt BC/yr (biomass burning)

parameters.name: oc_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial OC emissions, from biomass burning by default

unit: Mt OC/yr

Default: 10.0 Mt OC/yr (biomass burning)

parameters.name: nox_pi
parameters.description:
Pre-industrial NOx emissions for nitrate, from natural sources by default

unit: Mt N/yr

Default: 10.0 Mt N/yr (natural sources)

parameters.name: include_harmonisation
parameters.description:
Scale the ERF to a target value in a reference year.

When true, the ERF is scaled so that its value at `harmonisation_reference_year`
equals `harmonisation_target`.
The component does not apply it yet.

parameters.name: harmonisation_reference_year
parameters.description:
Reference year for harmonisation

unit: yr

Default: 2019.0

parameters.name: harmonisation_target
parameters.description:
Target ERF in the reference year.

unit: W/m^2


Default: -0.22 W/m² (AR6 central estimate for direct aerosol)
